svg.title: Modular agent architecture — core, domain modules, config layer, deployed agent
svg.desc: Three-tier architecture showing a universal core shell at the top, a selectable module library in the middle, a client config layer, and the deployed agent at the bottom. The 12 niches are grouped into 4 domain families below.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What exactly goes inside the universal core shell of the agent?')
g.text: Always deployed · greeting, intent routing, fallback, escalation, CSAT, session logging

svg.text: Module library — mix and match per client

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What intents and workflows go inside the Booking and Scheduling module?')
sendPrompt('What intents and workflows go inside the Service and Quote module?')
sendPrompt('What intents and workflows go inside the Order and Returns module?')
sendPrompt('What goes inside the FAQ and Knowledge module?')
sendPrompt('What goes inside the Complaint and Escalation module?')
sendPrompt('What goes inside the Smart Memory and CRM module?')
sendPrompt('What does the client config layer include — what does a client fill in to personalise their agent?')
g.text: Brand name & tone · business data · API credentials · persona · escalation contact

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the final deployed agent look like from the clients perspective?')
g.text: Core + selected modules + client config = live branded agent, ready in days not weeks

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Which of the 12 niches fall into the appointment-based domain family?')
